data.summary: BFSI professional with experience in client onboarding, KYC/CKYC operations, and AML due diligence gained across Nexdigm, DBS Bank, and SBI Securities. Knowledge of CDD, EDD, PEP, and Sanctions screening, applied while reviewing onboarding documentation, verifying client information via the CERSAI portal, and independently identifying and escalating discrepancies. Certified in Retail Banking, AML/KYC Compliance, Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Advanced Excel. Fluent in English, Hindi, and Marathi, with a strong record of accurate, SLA-compliant case handling.

raw_sections.skills: CORE SKILLS • Client Onboarding Process Management & Documentation Review • KYC / CKYC / Re-KYC Processing & Client Onboarding Documentation Review • AML Due Diligence: CDD, EDD, PEP & Sanctions Screening Concepts • Discrepancy Identification, Investigation & Escalation • CERSAI Portal Verification & Registry Updates • Client Query Resolution, Case Tracking & SLA / Compliance Adherence • Systems: TrackWizz & Internal Onboarding Tools, AOS, CMCP, CERSAI Portal, Advanced Excel • Multilingual Communication: English, Hindi, Marathi
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Associate | Nexdigm • Manage the end-to-end client onboarding process, reviewing documentation and coordinating with internal stakeholders to
Jul 2026 – Present
ensure accurate, timely, and compliant account setup.
Use TrackWizz and internal onboarding tools to process, track, and update client records throughout the onboarding lifecycle. • Apply working knowledge of KYC and AML due diligence standards to review onboarding documentation and flag discrepancies for resolution.
CKYC Operations Executive | DBS Bank • Reviewed onboarding and KYC documentation for 300+ cases per month, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance
Nov 2025 – Jul 2026
with regulatory and bank policy standards.
Verified client information via the CERSAI portal against internal/external sources, personally identifying and escalating discrepancies and risk indicators for timely resolution.
Updated customer records and internal systems (TrackWizz, AOS, CMCP) within defined turnaround timelines, applying working knowledge of CDD, EDD, PEP, and Sanctions screening.
Updated and maintained customer information across TrackWizz, AOS, and CMCP within defined TAT/SLA requirements.
Supported securities account and portfolio-related operations, ensuring accurate capture and maintenance of client, account, and portfolio information.
Reviewed trade and transaction-related information for completeness and accuracy and coordinated with relevant teams

to resolve discrepancies. Identified, investigated, and escalated client-data discrepancies, documentation gaps, duplicate/inconsistent information, and risk indicators for timely resolution.
Performed UAT and Live Verification (LV) testing and maintained detailed case logs, supporting audit readiness and data quality standards.
Relationship Officer | SBI Securities • Onboarded 150+ clients into the system, accurately capturing KYC, account, and portfolio details to support portfolio
Jan 2025 – Nov 2025
management services.
Acted as a point of contact for client queries related to onboarding and account setup, offering suitable alternatives to support client retention.
supported client account setup and activation, ensuring required documentation and client information were complete, accurate, and compliant with internal requirements.
Ensured timely completion of onboarding activities while maintaining high standards of data accuracy and regulatory compliance.
Coordinated with clients for documentation and follow-ups, helping reduce delays in account activation. • Maintained accurate client records in line with internal process and regulatory guidelines.
